response.rationale: A covers payment processing: taking payments and issuing refunds. It sits in community:3, which is built around PuckPayClient (fan-in 3) alongside the booking, hire-stock and session repositories. B covers selling tickets, with online payment as part of the sale. Its scope is the whole business component, which also includes ClubService, ReportService and IceMonitorService. The two share RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1) and both involve online payment. Even so, A is about payment and refund handling and B is about the ticket-sales flow, so they are related but not the same capability. Confidence is moderate because only the class declarations are visible and none of the payment or refund logic can be checked.
